Contact Bounty

Email kunal26das@gmail.com. Include the app version shown in Your corner, your platform, what you expected, what happened and the steps that reproduce the problem. Include only the minimum account information needed to identify your request. A screenshot is optional; remove other people's names, expense details and private information first.

Never send passwords, one-time codes, session tokens, private keys, full payment-card details or an unredacted ledger. Sending support mail opens your email app; nothing is submitted automatically by these pages.

Protect a saved ledger

Before reinstalling, clearing app or browser data, importing a replacement backup or changing accounts, use Your corner → Your data → Ledger backup. Also keep the original receipt files: backups contain receipt references, not attachment bytes. An exported file may include other participants' data, so store it privately.

Cloud sharing is paused. Local and Demo remain usable, and previously saved Cloud data is read-only and exportable. Pending Cloud changes are preserved on the device. Signing out does not erase those saved records and does not transfer them to another account.

If a saved session used retired email/password sign-in, preserve the session and export before signing out. Google or Apple must already identify the same Bounty account to recover its access. Matching email text is not proof of account ownership, and no automatic account merge is available.

Subscriptions and account deletion

Use Restore purchases while signed in to the intended Bounty identity, or use Manage subscriptions for the provider's renewal controls. A purchase reference can help investigate an access problem; never include card details or a store password.

For account or data removal, read Account and data deletion and email a clear request. Automatic cloud deletion is paused, so the app must not show success before the requested work has actually completed. Cancelling a subscription and deleting an account are separate actions.

Prepare a support email ↗

Opens your email app. Review the message before sending; no request is submitted by this page. Sending a message does not confirm deletion or cancel a subscription.
